title: Interval VWAP of market trades over the order window
deliverables: summary: vwap, total volume, trade count
frame: DIKETAHUI: trades [n_tr] (time, price, size); window [start, end). DITANYAKAN: interval VWAP (currency per share), volume, count. RUMUS: Core 1 VWAP = sum(p q)/sum(q); V1 default interval VWAP. JAWAB: 1) stable sort by time. 2) mask start <= t < end. 3) VWAP. 4) check low <= VWAP <= high; write.
pitfalls: closed end double-counts boundary prints

title: Full-day vs interval VWAP benchmark comparison
frame: DIKETAHUI: market trades for the day [n_tr], order fills [n_f], order window, side. DITANYAKAN: order avg fill price and slippage vs both VWAPs in bps. RUMUS: Core 1 and 3: slip = s(avg_fill - VWAP)/VWAP*1e4. JAWAB: 1) day VWAP over RTH. 2) interval VWAP over order window. 3) avg fill = sum(p q)/sum(q) of fills. 4) signed slippage both; write.

title: Per-bucket VWAP table of market trades
deliverables: per-bucket table [B]: bucket_start, trades, volume, vwap
frame: DIKETAHUI: trades [n_tr]; bucket length; session start/end. DITANYAKAN: per bucket: count, volume, VWAP [B]; empty buckets with zero count. RUMUS: Core 1 per bucket; bucket id = floor((t - start)/len), half-open. JAWAB: 1) bucket id per trade. 2) groupby sum(pq), sum(q), count. 3) reindex full grid, empty -> 0 count and blank VWAP. 4) check totals = window totals; write.
pitfalls: dropping empty buckets from the grid

title: TWAP schedule: equal child sizes per slice, integer shares
frame: DIKETAHUI: parent quantity Q, start, end, number of slices N (or slice length). DITANYAKAN: child quantity per slice [N] summing to Q. RUMUS: Core 1 TWAP weights 1/N; Core 10 largest remainder for integers. JAWAB: 1) slice grid. 2) target Q/N each. 3) floor, give leftover to earliest slices (ties earlier). 4) cumulative ends at Q; write.
pitfalls: round() causing sum mismatch

title: TWAP benchmark price over slices
frame: DIKETAHUI: trades or mid quotes [n]; window; slice length. DITANYAKAN: TWAP benchmark (mean of slice prices) and fill slippage vs it. RUMUS: Core 1 TWAP = mean over slices of last (or average) price per slice as stated. JAWAB: 1) slice grid. 2) price per slice (last trade or prevailing mid). 3) mean over non-empty slices. 4) slippage; write.

title: POV child orders per bucket with remaining and cap
deliverables: per-bucket table [B]: market volume, child, cumulative, remaining
frame: DIKETAHUI: bucket market volumes V_b [B], target Q, rate rho, max_child. DITANYAKAN: child per bucket, cumulative, remaining, fill rate. RUMUS: Core 2 child_b = min(remaining, floor(rho V_b), max_child). JAWAB: 1) iterate buckets in time order. 2) child. 3) update remaining. 4) fill_rate = executed/Q in [0,1]; check remaining non-increasing; write.
pitfalls: using own fills inside V_b (market volume excludes own) unless stated

title: POV with own-volume inclusion
frame: DIKETAHUI: other-trader volumes V_b [B], rho, Q. DITANYAKAN: child per bucket when participation is defined on total volume including own. RUMUS: child/(V_b+child) = rho -> child = rho V_b/(1-rho); then caps. JAWAB: 1) inclusive child. 2) cap by remaining and max. 3) realised participation = child/(V_b+child). 4) write.

title: Arrival-price slippage / implementation shortfall in bps
frame: DIKETAHUI: orders [M] (side, decision time, fills [n_f] with price, qty), quotes. DITANYAKAN: IS in bps per order (positive = cost). RUMUS: Core 3 IS = s(avg_fill - P_arr)/P_arr*1e4; V2 arrival = prevailing mid at decision time. JAWAB: 1) prevailing quote at or before decision -> mid. 2) avg fill. 3) signed bps. 4) sell s=-1; write.
pitfalls: sell-side sign not flipped

title: Perold implementation shortfall with opportunity cost
deliverables: summary: execution cost, opportunity cost, fees, total IS (currency and bps)
frame: DIKETAHUI: target Q, side, P_arr, fills (p, q), end price P_end, fees. DITANYAKAN: execution, opportunity, fee and total shortfall. RUMUS: Core 3 exec = s sum q_i(p_i - P_arr); opp = s(P_end - P_arr)(Q - sum q); total / (Q P_arr) *1e4. JAWAB: 1) executed and unfilled. 2) components. 3) total. 4) bps on paper notional Q P_arr; write.
pitfalls: bps on executed instead of target notional

title: IS decomposition: delay, trading, opportunity
frame: DIKETAHUI: decision price P_d, release/arrival price P_0, fills, end price, Q, side. DITANYAKAN: IS components bps. RUMUS: delay = s(P_0 - P_d)X; trading = s sum q(p - P_0); opp = s(P_end - P_d)(Q - X); normalise by Q P_d. JAWAB: 1) X executed. 2) components. 3) sum = total vs decision price. 4) write.

title: Effective spread per trade with prevailing quote
frame: DIKETAHUI: trades [n_tr] (time, price, size, side?), quotes [n_q] (time, bid, ask). DITANYAKAN: effective spread per trade and average. RUMUS: Core 4 effective = 2s(P - M)/M; V4 default with factor 2. JAWAB: 1) merge_asof backward on time (last quote at or before). 2) mid. 3) side given or Lee-Ready. 4) bps x1e4. 5) mean (or size-weighted if stated); write.
pitfalls: next quote used instead of prevailing

title: Realized spread and price impact at horizon
frame: DIKETAHUI: trades [n_tr], quotes [n_q], horizon D. DITANYAKAN: effective, realized, impact per trade; identity residual. RUMUS: Core 4 realized = 2s(P - M_{t+D})/M; impact = 2s(M_{t+D} - M)/M; effective = realized + impact. JAWAB: 1) M at t (prevailing). 2) M_{t+D}: prevailing at t+D. 3) components with denominator M at trade. 4) check identity; write.
pitfalls: dividing realized by future mid

title: Half-spread effective cost variant
frame: DIKETAHUI: trades, quotes, side; definitions in task text. DITANYAKAN: half-spread cost per trade. RUMUS: V4 (b) s(P - M)/M; if temporary impact defined without 2 then effective = realized + 2*impact. JAWAB: 1) prevailing mid. 2) s(P-M)/M*1e4. 3) adapt identity per stated definition; write.
pitfalls: 1e4 vs 2e4 multipliers swapped

title: Quoted and relative quoted spread, time-weighted
deliverables: summary: mean quoted spread, time-weighted relative spread (bps)
frame: DIKETAHUI: quotes [n_q] (time, bid, ask), window. DITANYAKAN: average quoted spread and relative spread. RUMUS: Core 5 quoted = ask - bid; relative = (ask-bid)/mid; time weight = duration until next quote (clipped at window end). JAWAB: 1) filter bid <= ask, window. 2) durations. 3) simple and time-weighted means. 4) bps; write.
formulas: TW = sum w_i x_i / sum w_i

title: Roll implied spread estimator
deliverables: summary: cov, roll_spread (or NaN if cov >= 0)
frame: DIKETAHUI: trade prices [n] (or daily closes). DITANYAKAN: Roll spread estimate. RUMUS: Core 5 s = 2 sqrt(-cov(dp_t, dp_{t-1})) when cov<0. JAWAB: 1) dp. 2) first-order autocovariance (state ddof). 3) s or NaN/0 per text. 4) relative = s/mean price; write.

title: Lee-Ready trade sign classification
frame: DIKETAHUI: trades [n_tr], quotes [n_q]. DITANYAKAN: sign +1/-1 per trade. RUMUS: Core 13 P>mid buy, P<mid sell, P=mid tick rule (uptick buy, downtick sell, zero tick previous sign). JAWAB: 1) prevailing quote (optionally lag per text). 2) quote rule. 3) tick rule for midpoint trades. 4) write signs.
formulas: sign = sgn(P - M), else tick rule

title: Tick rule classification only
frame: DIKETAHUI: trade prices [n] in time order, sizes. DITANYAKAN: sign per trade and signed volume. RUMUS: sign = sgn(p_t - p_{t-1}), zero tick carries previous sign; first trade undefined/0. JAWAB: 1) diff. 2) ffill nonzero signs. 3) signed vol = sign*size. 4) write.

title: Prevailing vs next quote matching for TCA
deliverables: per-trade table: matched quote time, bid, ask, mid
frame: DIKETAHUI: trades [n_tr] and quotes [n_q] with multiple timestamps. DITANYAKAN: matched quote per trade under the stated rule. RUMUS: Conventions: default last quote at or before t (backward); 'first quote at or after' -> forward; use exchange/transaction time. JAWAB: 1) stable sort both. 2) merge_asof direction. 3) keep quote timestamps as separate fields. 4) write.
pitfalls: event_time vs transaction_time mixed

title: Size-weighted average effective spread across trades
deliverables: summary: equal-weighted, share-weighted, dollar-weighted effective bps
frame: DIKETAHUI: per-trade effective spreads [n_tr], sizes, prices. DITANYAKAN: average effective spread under each weighting. RUMUS: weights q or p*q; mean = sum w e/sum w. JAWAB: 1) per-trade eff. 2) weights. 3) three means. 4) write.
formulas: avg = sum w_i e_i / sum w_i

title: Almgren-Chriss discrete optimal liquidation trajectory
deliverables: per-step table [N+1]: t_j, holdings x_j, trade n_j
frame: DIKETAHUI: X shares, T, N slices, sigma, eta, gamma, eps, lambda. DITANYAKAN: holdings and trades per slice. RUMUS: Core 6 eta~ = eta - gamma tau/2; k from (2/tau^2)(cosh(k tau)-1) = lambda sigma^2/eta~; x_j = X sinh(k(T-t_j))/sinh(kT). JAWAB: 1) tau = T/N. 2) solve k = arccosh(1 + lambda sigma^2 tau^2/(2 eta~))/tau. 3) x_j. 4) n_j = x_{j-1}-x_j. 5) check x_0=X, x_N=0, monotone; write.
pitfalls: using continuous k in the discrete formula without stating it

title: Almgren-Chriss expected cost and variance; efficient frontier
deliverables: per-lambda table: E, Var, E + lambda Var
frame: DIKETAHUI: AC parameters, lambda grid [L]. DITANYAKAN: E[cost], Var[cost] per lambda and objective. RUMUS: Core 6 E = gamma X^2/2 + eps sum|n_j| + (eta~/tau) sum n_j^2; Var = sigma^2 tau sum x_j^2. JAWAB: 1) trajectory per lambda. 2) E, Var (sum over j=1..N). 3) frontier monotone: higher lambda -> lower Var, higher E; write.
formulas: E = gamma X^2/2 + eps sum|n| + (eta~/tau) sum n^2

title: Almgren-Chriss lambda=0 TWAP limit check
frame: DIKETAHUI: AC parameters with lambda = 0. DITANYAKAN: trajectory and cost. RUMUS: Core 6 lambda=0 -> x_j = X(1 - t_j/T), n_j = X/N. JAWAB: 1) linear schedule. 2) E with sum n^2 = X^2/N. 3) Var. 4) write.

title: Almgren-Chriss continuous-time approximation
frame: DIKETAHUI: X, T, sigma, eta, lambda, time grid. DITANYAKAN: continuous trajectory and urgency. RUMUS: Core 6 k = sqrt(lambda sigma^2/eta); x(t) = X sinh(k(T-t))/sinh(kT); half-life 1/k. JAWAB: 1) k. 2) evaluate grid. 3) write.

title: Square-root market impact estimate
deliverables: per-order table: Q/ADV, impact_bps, impact cost currency
frame: DIKETAHUI: orders [M] (Q), ADV, sigma_daily, Y. DITANYAKAN: expected impact bps and cost. RUMUS: Core 7 I = Y sigma_daily sqrt(Q/ADV). JAWAB: 1) sigma daily from returns if needed (std ddof=1). 2) I fraction. 3) bps, cost = I Q P. 4) write.
pitfalls: annual sigma used as daily

title: Pre-trade cost estimate: spread plus impact
frame: DIKETAHUI: orders [M], quoted spread, ADV, sigma, Y. DITANYAKAN: total expected cost bps. RUMUS: half-spread (ask-bid)/(2 mid) + Core 7 impact. JAWAB: 1) relative half spread. 2) impact. 3) total. 4) write.

title: Intraday volume profile: mean of daily shares
frame: DIKETAHUI: volume bars [D x B] for D complete days. DITANYAKAN: mean share per bar [B] summing to 1. RUMUS: Core 8 s_{d,b} = V_{d,b}/sum_b V_{d,b}; profile = mean_d s_{d,b}, renormalised. JAWAB: 1) drop incomplete days. 2) shares per day. 3) mean across days. 4) renormalise; check sum=1; write.
pitfalls: averaging raw volumes then normalising (different estimator)

title: Median volume profile per bar
frame: DIKETAHUI: bars [D x B]. DITANYAKAN: median share per bar summing to 1. RUMUS: Core 8 median over days per bar, then renormalise. JAWAB: 1) daily shares. 2) median axis=days. 3) renormalise. 4) write.

title: EWMA volume profile with half-life
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily shares [D x B] ordered oldest->newest, half-life H. DITANYAKAN: EWMA profile summing to 1. RUMUS: Core 8 w_L = exp(-ln2 L/H), L=0 most recent day; normalise weights; profile = sum w s / sum w; renormalise. JAWAB: 1) lag L per day. 2) weights. 3) weighted mean per bar. 4) renormalise; write.
pitfalls: weights reversed (most weight on oldest day)

title: Winsorised mean volume profile
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily shares [D x B]; percentiles (P5/P95). DITANYAKAN: winsorised mean per bar summing to 1. RUMUS: Core 8 clip each bar across days at its own P5/P95 (numpy linear), mean, renormalise. JAWAB: 1) per bar quantiles across days. 2) clip. 3) mean. 4) renormalise; write.
pitfalls: winsorising across bars instead of across days

title: Volume profile model scoring by daily R2 walk-forward
deliverables: summary: mean r2 per model, best model
frame: DIKETAHUI: bars [D x B], window W, candidate profile models. DITANYAKAN: mean of daily out-of-sample R2 per model. RUMUS: Core 9 R2_d = 1 - sum(s - shat)^2/sum(s - mean s)^2; estimate on W complete days strictly before d. JAWAB: 1) for each test day d>=W fit profiles on d-W..d-1. 2) R2_d. 3) mean (not pooled). 4) pick best; write.
pitfalls: pooled R2 across days

title: Integer schedule from weights by largest remainder
frame: DIKETAHUI: weights w_b [B] summing to 1, Q. DITANYAKAN: integer child per bar summing to Q. RUMUS: Core 10 floor(Q w_b); leftover units to largest fractional parts; ties to earlier bar (stable argsort of -frac). JAWAB: 1) raw = Q w. 2) floor. 3) leftover = Q - sum. 4) distribute. 5) check sum; write.
pitfalls: ties to the later bar

title: VWAP schedule over remaining bars after decision time
deliverables: per-bar table: bar_start, weight, child, cumulative
frame: DIKETAHUI: historical profile [B], decision time, Q. DITANYAKAN: integer schedule over bars starting strictly after decision time. RUMUS: Conventions: keep bars with start > decision; renormalise; zero sum -> uniform; Core 10 integers. JAWAB: 1) filter bars. 2) renormalise. 3) largest remainder. 4) check cumulative ends at Q; write.

title: Resampling trades to 5-minute bars, complete days
deliverables: table [D x B]: volume per bar
frame: DIKETAHUI: trades with timestamps (tz), RTH 09:30-16:00. DITANYAKAN: bar volumes per day and count of complete days. RUMUS: Conventions: label=left, closed=left; 78 bars; drop empty resample buckets; exclude half-days. JAWAB: 1) localise tz, filter RTH half-open (16:00 print only if specified). 2) resample. 3) keep days with all 78 bars. 4) write.
pitfalls: right-labelled bars shift every bar

title: U-shape profile statistics
deliverables: summary: first-k share, last-k share, midday share, ratio
frame: DIKETAHUI: profile [B] or bars [D x B]; k. DITANYAKAN: shares in open, midday, close segments. RUMUS: sum of profile over segment ranges. JAWAB: 1) profile. 2) segment sums. 3) ratios. 4) write.

title: Order flow imbalance per book update (CKS)
frame: DIKETAHUI: L1 book snapshots [n] (Pb, qb, Pa, qa). DITANYAKAN: OFI contribution per event and sum. RUMUS: Core 11 e = 1{Pb>=Pb'}qb - 1{Pb<=Pb'}qb' - 1{Pa<=Pa'}qa + 1{Pa>=Pa'}qa'. JAWAB: 1) previous row values. 2) e per row (first NaN/0). 3) sum per interval. 4) write.

title: OFI aggregated per interval and price-impact regression
frame: DIKETAHUI: L1 events [n], interval length. DITANYAKAN: OFI per interval and OLS dMid on OFI. RUMUS: Core 11; toolkit ols(y=dmid, X=ofi). JAWAB: 1) e per event. 2) sum per interval; dmid = mid_end - mid_start. 3) OLS. 4) write.

title: Flow-form and depth-weighted multi-level OFI
frame: DIKETAHUI: order messages [n] (side, type, size, level/distance). DITANYAKAN: OFI per interval. RUMUS: Core 11 flow per side = limit - cancel - market; OFI = bid flow - ask flow; weight 1/(1+|distance|) if asked. JAWAB: 1) classify messages. 2) signed contributions. 3) weights. 4) aggregate; write.

title: Order book imbalance and microprice
frame: DIKETAHUI: snapshots [n] (Pb, qb, Pa, qa). DITANYAKAN: mid, imbalance, microprice per row. RUMUS: Core 12 I = (qb-qa)/(qb+qa); micro = (Pa qb + Pb qa)/(qb+qa). JAWAB: 1) row-wise. 2) check bid <= micro <= ask, I in [-1,1]. 3) write.
pitfalls: swapping qa and qb in the microprice

title: Walking the book for a marketable order
deliverables: summary: avg price, slippage_bps vs mid, unfilled
frame: DIKETAHUI: book levels [L] (price, size) on the opposite side, order Q, side. DITANYAKAN: fills per level, average price, slippage vs mid/touch. RUMUS: consume levels best-first: fill_l = min(rem, size_l). JAWAB: 1) sort levels best-first. 2) consume. 3) avg = sum p f/sum f. 4) slippage bps vs mid. 5) write.

title: Rolling OLS prediction of next mid return from book features
frame: DIKETAHUI: feature matrix [T x k], mids [T], window W. DITANYAKAN: prediction per row from model fit on [t-W, t-1]. RUMUS: target y_t = ln(m_{t+1}/m_t); z-score with training mean and std ddof=0; OLS fit; toolkit ols, spearman_ic. JAWAB: 1) target (last NaN). 2) per t fit on prior W rows with non-NaN target. 3) transform row t, predict. 4) metrics; write.
pitfalls: dropping rows up front shifts indices

title: Rolling PCA signal with sign anchoring
frame: DIKETAHUI: features [T x k], window W, anchor feature. DITANYAKAN: PC1 score per row from rolling fit. RUMUS: fit scaler and PCA on [t-W, t-1]; flip loadings so corr(PC1_train, anchor) >= 0; apply same transform and flip to row t. JAWAB: 1) per t fit. 2) sign decide on training scores. 3) project row t. 4) write.
pitfalls: re-testing sign on already-flipped series

title: TCA summary aggregated by broker or algo
deliverables: per-group table: orders, notional, mean is_bps, notional-weighted is_bps
frame: DIKETAHUI: orders [M] with IS bps, notional, group label. DITANYAKAN: per-group statistics. RUMUS: weighted mean = sum notional*IS / sum notional. JAWAB: 1) IS per order. 2) groupby. 3) both means. 4) write.
formulas: IS_w = sum N_i IS_i / sum N_i

title: Kyle lambda estimation
frame: DIKETAHUI: intervals [K] with price change and signed volume (or trades to sign). DITANYAKAN: price-impact coefficient. RUMUS: dP_k = a + lambda Q_signed,k + e; toolkit ols. JAWAB: 1) sign trades (Lee-Ready). 2) aggregate per interval. 3) OLS. 4) write.

title: Amihud illiquidity measure
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily returns [T], dollar volume [T]. DITANYAKAN: Amihud ILLIQ. RUMUS: ILLIQ = mean(|r_t|/DVOL_t) (scale e.g. 1e6 if stated). JAWAB: 1) drop zero-volume days. 2) ratio. 3) mean, scale. 4) write.

title: Simulated marketable fills at the touch
deliverables: per-child table: time, side, qty, fill price
frame: DIKETAHUI: child schedule [B], quotes [n_q]. DITANYAKAN: fill price per child and avg price. RUMUS: Conventions: buy at prevailing ask, sell at bid; full fill at touch unless book walk stated. JAWAB: 1) child time. 2) prevailing quote. 3) fill price. 4) avg and IS; write.

title: Realised participation rate of an order
frame: DIKETAHUI: own fills, market trades over [start, end). DITANYAKAN: participation = executed/market volume. RUMUS: rate = X/V_mkt (or X/(V_mkt+X) if own volume excluded from tape). JAWAB: 1) sum fills. 2) sum market volume same window. 3) ratio; write.

title: POV schedule from forecast volume profile
deliverables: per-bucket table: forecast volume, planned child, cumulative
frame: DIKETAHUI: ADV, profile [B], rho, Q, start bar. DITANYAKAN: planned child per bucket and completion bar. RUMUS: V_b_hat = ADV p_b; child = min(rem, rho V_b_hat). JAWAB: 1) forecast. 2) iterate. 3) completion = first bar remaining=0. 4) integers by floor; write.

title: Implementation shortfall in currency vs bps
frame: DIKETAHUI: orders [M] with fills, arrival, side. DITANYAKAN: IS in currency and bps. RUMUS: IS_ccy = s sum q(p - P_arr); bps = IS_ccy/(X P_arr)*1e4. JAWAB: 1) arrival. 2) currency cost. 3) bps. 4) totals = sums of currency, bps recomputed from totals; write.
pitfalls: averaging bps across orders when aggregate bps is asked

title: Mark-out analysis at multiple horizons
frame: DIKETAHUI: fills [n_f] (time, price, side), quotes, horizons [H]. DITANYAKAN: average signed markout per horizon. RUMUS: markout_h = s(M_{t+h} - P)/P*1e4 (positive = favourable for liquidity taker as defined). JAWAB: 1) prevailing mid at t+h. 2) signed. 3) mean per horizon. 4) write.

title: Price improvement vs NBBO (Rule 605 style)
deliverables: summary: pct improved, at quote, outside, avg improvement per share
frame: DIKETAHUI: fills [n_f] (side, price, qty), NBBO at order receipt. DITANYAKAN: share of fills improved and average improvement. RUMUS: improvement = ask - P (buy), P - bid (sell). JAWAB: 1) NBBO at receipt time. 2) improvement per fill. 3) classify >0, =0, <0. 4) share-weighted stats; write.

title: Child order cumulative execution tracking vs schedule
deliverables: per-bucket table: planned cum, actual cum, deviation
frame: DIKETAHUI: planned schedule [B], actual fills [n_f]. DITANYAKAN: cumulative planned vs actual and deviation. RUMUS: dev_b = actual_cum_b - planned_cum_b. JAWAB: 1) bucket fills. 2) cumsums. 3) deviation, max abs. 4) write.

title: Closing-price benchmark slippage
frame: DIKETAHUI: orders with fills, official close. DITANYAKAN: slippage vs close. RUMUS: slip = s(avg_fill - P_close)/P_close*1e4. JAWAB: 1) close per symbol/day. 2) avg fill. 3) bps; write.
